notes: Odoo has no REST surface. Every precondition is one POST to /web/dataset/call_kw with a model and a method, which is why this file lists three endpoints rather than hundreds — the variety is in the payload, not in the paths.
The model and field names a payload needs are in each addon's models/*.py.
